description: Look up one App Store or Google Play app: title, subtitle, developer, category, price, rating and histogram, installs (Play), version and dates, description, languages, and the same app in the other store. Accepts any id, bundle id, package, store URL or a name. Reads stored data (refreshed from the store only when older than max_age, default 7 days) for one country (default us); add include sections for markets, versions, IAP, privacy, estimates and chart positions. Cost: 1 + 1 per country refreshed from the store (max 10) credits.

app.description: Any app identifier: App Store id (`284882215`, `id284882215`), Play package (`com.spotify.music`), Apple bundle id (`com.spotify.client`), store URL (URL-encoded), `apple:<id>` / `play:<id>`, or a name (`spotify`). Example: com.spotify.music

country.description: ISO country code(s): `us` (default), a comma list (paid plans), or `all` (Studio). Example: us,de

format.description: 'markdown' (default): compact tables for reading. 'json': the API's raw { data, meta }

full_text.description: Return long text (description, release notes, review bodies) in full instead of cut short

include.description: Extra sections: markets (every storefront), iap, versions (history with release notes), privacy (App Store labels), estimates (modelled downloads/revenue), charts (current top-chart positions)

max_age.description: Refresh from the store when our data is older than this many seconds (0 = always). Default 604800 (7 days).

store.description: Disambiguates `{app}` (a bundle id vs a Play package, or a name).

wait.description: Block up to ~25 s for a refresh (default). false = answer immediately from cache with a job id.

name: get_app
title: Get App
